title: Closures with make-counter
description: make-counter returns a closure that captures its own count variable, allowing multiple independent counters.

steps.description: Reveal make-counter: defines a function that returns a closure capturing count.
Focus on let binding: count starts at 0, captured by the lambda that forms the closure.
Reveal counter instances: counter1 and counter2 each have their own captured count.

steps.question: What does the first (counter1) call return?

steps.description: Reveal calls: counter1 increments to 1 then 2, counter2 starts at 1, counter1 goes to 3.
Focus on lambda body: set! updates count, then returns it.
